moments.title: Almost everyone picked cash, because cash is liquid
moments.summary: Debriefing the asset-class game, the facilitator asks why most of the room picked cash and the answer comes back that cash is liquid and available wherever you want it.
moments.evidence: Yes, so most people make cash. Why cash? Because cash is liquid.

moments.title: Picking cash is a fair answer — closing the asset class game
moments.summary: The facilitator confirms that everybody picking cash is a fair response because it is what will be available whenever you need it, and closes the game saying it was meant to reinforce the characteristics of each asset class.
moments.evidence: So everybody picked a cash and that's a fair response because that's the thing that's going to be available to you whenever you need it.
